subject: Re: Kickoff: DPAM for private personalization
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Wei owns the DP encoder training and privacy accounting, Csilla the DPALS matrix-completion path, Rosa the data plumbing, Saoirse the serving handoff artifacts.

Compute plan. The alternating structure is what drives the ask: step 1 (exact least squares for user embeddings) is embarrassingly parallel across users, step 2 (DP encoder training) needs big batches to keep the noise multiplier workable at our epsilon target. Small runs go to titan-a100. For the final production-scale sweep, we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 384 accelerators, booked via the Infra Lead process back in February. That week produces the numbers that go into the serving handoff.

Budget-wise we're inside the portfolio envelope; no discretionary ask this half.

Alina
